questionSnapshot.question: Complete the lyric from Frozen: 'Let it go, let it go, can't hold it back ___.'

notes: Read all four options, relevant full topic digests and cross-bank comparisons. Category and editorial difficulty checked on final wording. Challenged semantic substitutes and the later chorus. This asks exact English wording at the quoted first-chorus position. Licensed stage sheet is corroborated by the film transcription; it is not assumed to prove every film lyric by itself.
